newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF says plans to hold 2-yr note auction on Friday.
newsitem.headline: MOF says plans to hold 2-yr note auction on Friday.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) is planning to offer two-year government notes through a price-competitive auction on Friday, a ministry official said on Thursday.
Market sources said the issue amount would likely be around 120 billion yen.
In the previous two-year note auction held on April 24, the issue amount was 120 billion yen and the coupon rate for the offered two-year notes set at 0.7 percent.
